notable_absence.finding: This thin procedural page never states which role is required to delete an organization - it defers entirely to Couchbase Support ('Contact Couchbase Capella Support... Couchbase Support will help you settle any remaining billing obligations and delete your organization'), so organization deletion is not a self-service, role-gated UI action the way user/role management is elsewhere in this batch. Also no edition badges or server-version-string citations (both known recurring anomalies absent, as expected).

cross_component_finding: Deleting an organization is explicitly a support-mediated process, not a Capella-UI action gated by capella-role:*; this contrasts with every other organization-management action in this batch (invite/remove/role-change), which are all self-service and Organization-Owner-gated.
